images.edition: Correspondentie van Willem III en van Hans Willem Bentinck, eerste gedeelte, deel 2, KS 24
images.content: Alphabetische lijst van brieven -- the Vaudemont correspondent index, listing every letter by date with an asterisk marking cipher letters; the 25 March 1699 entry carries the note 'grootendeels in onopgelost cijferschrift; ook een ontcijferde brief is aanwezig'

note: This is the edition's own index page, not a letter text and not the manuscript. No archive shelfmark or inventory number is given on this page for the 25 March 1699 letter; the originals of this correspondence are in the Portland Papers, University of Nottingham (not Nationaal Archief 3.01.19), which CLAUDE.md's Access playbook already notes are NOT copy-free.
